QuestInfo.name: Deliver Orange Bricks
QuestInfo.1: When you delivered 100 clumps of Mud to JM, he made a #t4032802# out of them. Take the #t4032802# over to the Dark Lord.\n\n#i4032802##t4032802# #b#c4032802##k/10
QuestInfo.2: You safely delivered the #t4032802# that Dark Lord requested and received a pair of shoes as a reward.

0.0: Did you bring all the materials?
0.1: This should be enough... It will take me some time to make #t4032802#s, so please wait a moment.

yes.0: The #b#t4032802#s#k are ready now. Whew... this is pretty tough! Maybe I should hire an assistant...
yes.1: Here, take this #b#t4032802##k to #b#p1052001##k, so that he can complete the construction.

no.0: Hmm... Are you looking for bricks?

1.0: Ahh, you're the one who accepted my request? So, have you brought the bricks?
1.1: Well, you really brought #b10 #t4032802#s#k. They must have been hard to obtain. Good job. There are so many places in Kerning City that need repair. I don't want any residents of Kerning City getting hurt. Safely is the most important thing of all.

yes.0: Let me give you this as a token of my appreciation. It's important that your feet are comfortable when you are on an adventure. I hope that you enjoy them. Please don't complain about the color, though...

npc.0: Go see #b#p1052001##k... You do know where he is, right?

item.0: You haven't brought enough bricks... Come back when you have #b10 #t4032802#s#k.

lost.0: What? You lost the bricks? Lucky for you I used some left over Mud Clumps to make some extra. Take these and be sure not to lose them again...
